name: Parallel infrastructure design for SP2 and SP3

scenarios.name: ParallelSP2-01 SP2 Stage 3 slot-filling calls are independent per responsibility

steps.text: a control structure with 3 responsibilities
one LLM call specification per responsibility for Stage 3 slot-filling
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 3
three LLMCallResult objects are returned
each result corresponds to a different responsibility

scenarios.name: ParallelSP2-02 SP2 Stage 3 parallel calls produce same results as sequential

steps.text: a control structure with 3 responsibilities
one LLM call specification per responsibility for Stage 3 slot-filling
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 1
the results are identical to calling parallel_safe_llm_calls with max_workers 3

scenarios.name: ParallelSP3-01 SP3 Stage 5 BDI calls are independent per scenario

steps.text: 5 scenario seeds
one LLM call specification per scenario for Stage 5 BDI generation
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 4
five LLMCallResult objects are returned in input order
each result corresponds to a different scenario

scenarios.name: ParallelSP3-02 SP3 Stage 6 calls are independent within a scenario

steps.text: one scenario with a fixed ScenarioSpec
three LLM call specifications for narrative, attack_tree, and gherkin
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 3
three LLMCallResult objects are returned in input order
the first result is for the narrative call
the second result is for the attack_tree call
the third result is for the gherkin call

scenarios.name: ParallelSP3-03 SP3 different scenarios can run concurrently

steps.text: 3 scenario seeds
4 LLM call specifications per scenario (1 BDI + 3 concretization)
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 4
twelve LLMCallResult objects are returned in input order
all results for scenario 1 precede results for scenario 2 in the result list
all results for scenario 2 precede results for scenario 3 in the result list

scenarios.name: ParallelSP3-04 SP3 Stage 5 failure for one scenario does not block others

steps.text: 3 scenario seeds
one LLM call specification per scenario for Stage 5 BDI generation
the mock LLM raises an exception for scenario 2
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 3
three LLMCallResult objects are returned
the result for scenario 1 has no error
the result for scenario 2 has an error message
the result for scenario 3 has no error

background.text: the STPA parallel LLM module is importable
a mock LLM client that records call order
